title: Validate input videos before segmentation
user_visible_behavior: CLI and GUI runs reject missing, unreadable, or unsupported video inputs with a clear error before starting expensive pose extraction.

title: Keep CLI config behavior stable
user_visible_behavior: Users can run RallyClip with a TOML config file or explicit CLI flags and get consistent output paths, CSV options, and inference settings.

title: Preserve desktop and browser GUI processing flow
user_visible_behavior: Users can select a video, start segmentation, view progress, and receive completion or error status from the local GUI without losing device or output settings.
evidence_plan: Import regression: gui.app startup does not load torch, ultralytics, av, or numpy.
Backend defaults/runtime endpoints stay responsive without device probing on library startup.
Upload processing runs in an analysis worker subprocess and reports progress through the existing API.
Manual app launch confirms replay library opens quickly and New Match warmup does not bring inference memory into the parent process.
evidence: 2026-06-28: PYTHONPATH=src import probe showed gui.app imports in 0.216s with torch/ultralytics/av/numpy all unloaded. Tests passed: tests/test_gui_startup_imports.py; tests/test_gui_smoke.py::test_gui_health_and_defaults; tests/test_gui_smoke.py::test_gui_pipeline_streams_features_into_inference; tests/test_gui_e2e.py::test_config_defaults_contract; tests/test_gui_e2e.py::test_upload_rejects_non_video; tests/test_gui_e2e.py::test_upload_rejects_missing_field; tests/test_gui_e2e.py::test_default_job_completes. 2026-06-30: packaged Mac release on feat/first-release was built, Developer ID signed with hardened runtime, notarized by Apple, stapled, mounted, and Gatekeeper accepted the app from the DMG. User manually verified source-only native replay completed without the proxy freeze, packaged app launch worked, welcome persistence worked, and inference/replay smoke flow was acceptable for v0.1.0. 2026-06-30 update: downloaded/installed notarized DMG showed a blank QtWebEngine window; diagnostic launch showed V8 CodeRange OOM from missing hardened-runtime JIT entitlements. Fixed local dist app and fixed DMG now carry QtWebEngine/V8 entitlements and render, but the fixed DMG is pending Apple notarization/stapling before publication.
notes: Release startup blocker mitigated and v0.1.0 desktop flow is release-ready. Replay/library startup no longer imports analysis/transcode stack, /api/config/defaults is static, New Match warmup runs in a child process, and upload jobs run in an analysis worker subprocess so Torch/YOLO memory exits after completion/cancel. Production Mac replay uses native source playback; automatic proxy/HLS playback is not part of v0.1.0. Remaining separate tracked work: runtime-video-validation, ONNX/Ultralytics replacement, bundle slimming, CI/CD, and shared runtime/API restructuring. Release artifact publication is blocked until the entitlement-fixed DMG is notarized and stapled; the previous notarized DMG must not ship.
